versions.content: AUTOSAR shall provide a soft ware platform to support the developm ent of highly available systems Type: Valid Description: Availability of the Adaptive Platform is defined as the probability that platform services will operate satisfactorily at a given point in time. It excludes b oth preventive and corrective maintenance downtime. Availability is limited to normal runtime behavior (excluding e.g. software update) Rationale: Facilitate the development of highly available systems by using AUTOSAR platforms. Use Case: Highly availab le systems are required for automated driving applications. Applies to: AP , CP Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
